summary: Current deny-all client rules are appropriate for the existing server-only weatherInternal architecture. No client create/update/read bypass or self-assigned authority exists. This is source inspection, not an IAM or deployed penetration-test certification.

checks.updateBypass: Denied for create and update alike
checks.businessLogic: Flutter calls HTTPS; only server Admin SDK accesses Firestore
checks.storageAbuse: Direct client writes are denied; server abuse must be controlled outside rules
checks.typeSafety: No client input can reach a permitted write

residualRisk: Admin SDK and privileged credentials bypass these rules. IAM, server validation and quotas remain necessary. Proposed public insights require a new rules review before any change.
scope: firestore.rules at the audited branch; unchanged by this work; no emulator or live unauthorized-write probes performed
